scope: documented source contracts; no acquisition, native materialisation, training or jobs

target_definitions.fe_h: log10 iron-to-hydrogen abundance relative to the explicitly retained survey solar convention

activation_policy.repeat_policy: retain provenance; resolve dependency or model joint covariance before multiple active likelihood terms
activation_policy.split_unit: Gaia star plus linked family/cluster/dependency groups; inspected historical TEST is not fresh

evidence_limit: Archived inventory is an earlier snapshot, not a live filesystem census. Absence here means ingestion not verified, not proof a remote file does not exist.

sources.quality_contract: Preserve STARFLAG/ASPCAPFLAG, per-parameter PARAMFLAG, FE_H_FLAG and positive finite quoted errors; release-specific bit policy.
sources.dependency_contract: Released calibrated parameters; seismic gravity/temperature calibration and alternate reductions are dependencies, not independent observations.
sources.next_action: Retain raw/calibrated alternatives and element fields; DR19 analysis is a distinct version, not silently substituted.
sources.newer_public_analysis: SDSS DR20 carries APOGEE DR19 ASPCAP analysis/files unchanged. Our staged native source remains DR17; DR19/DR20 are not two independent analyses.

sources.quality_contract: Current publisher best practice: flag_sp==0 and snr_px_ccd3>30; ignore erroneous DR4 flag_fe_h. Element abundances require flag_X_fe==0. Preserve old policy separately.
sources.dependency_contract: Gravity uses external astrometric/photometric constraints; age/mass are model products. allspec repeats share reductions; no independent-count multiplication.
sources.next_action: Keep APOGEE and GALAH alternatives for overlapping Gaia IDs rather than precedence overwrite.

sources.quality_contract: Parse flags_gspspec character positions, individual abundance flags/upper limits, uncertainties and published calibration applicability; do not substitute rv_template_* or GSP-Phot.
sources.dependency_contract: Released atmospheric values uncalibrated; any published correction and its reference surveys must be versioned. RVS spectroscopy distinct from XP, but calibrated products may share reference surveys.
sources.next_action: Audit native schema and exact Gaia IDs before ingestion. A derived Fe/H=Fe/M+M/H needs explicit transformation, covariance and calibration; never rename M/H.

sources.release: final public DR5.1; ESO catalogue 411 version 4, published 2023-07-02

native_fields.candidate_atmospheric: Teff/logg/metallicity and element abundances; exact archive column mapping unresolved

sources.quality_contract: Freeze archive version, instrument/setup, recommended parameters, uncertainties, flags, homogenisation/node provenance and cluster membership before activation.
sources.dependency_contract: Homogenised node outputs and repeat instrument solutions share spectra/standards; cluster members must be group held out.
sources.next_action: Pin final public DR5.1 archive file/digest and native Fe/H field/error mapping. Preserve instrument/node provenance and distinguish internal iDR6 nomenclature; no catalogue count promoted to eligible rows.

native_fields.spectroscopic: Teff/logg/[m/H] indicator; native field mapping pending
native_fields.posterior_separate: BDASP parameters and m_h_bdasp; distinct astrometry-assisted product
native_fields.iron_candidate_separate: GAUGUIN Fe abundance product exists; exact column/error/flag mapping pending, never atmospheric m/H rename

sources.quality_contract: Preserve convergence, spectral morphology, S/N, parameter errors and release-specific flags; separate pipeline selections.
sources.dependency_contract: BDASP uses Gaia DR2 priors; seismic-calibrated giant subset shares seismic anchors. Legacy filenames containing rave do not certify raw catalogue flags or lineage.
sources.next_action: Acquire nothing in this audit; verify native provenance before use. Atmospheric m/H is not interchangeable with Fe/H or universal total M/H.

native_fields.sp_separate: FERRE/SP parameters and covariance; exact ordering must be retained

sources.quality_contract: Star/success/primary, S/N, positive finite error, association and pipeline validity cuts; preserve RVTAB-SP TARGETID alignment. Existing low-metallicity RVTAB alpha policy excludes FEH<=-2 for primary use.
sources.dependency_contract: Two pipelines use common DESI spectra and are correlated; duplicate coadds/programs share observations. Gaia association is not guaranteed by TARGETID.
sources.next_action: Bring sparse atmospheric observations into a new source version after quality/domain/overlap audit; retain existing staged counts as selected measurements, not new FIT counts.

sources.release: staged Li2025 DR10 CaT; DR12 v2 candidate
sources.pipeline: Li CaT; LASP LRS; MRS/CNN distinct

native_fields.staged: Li2025 CaT Fe/H with method/error/quality; not LASP full atmospheric catalogue
native_fields.candidate: LASP Teff/logg/[Fe/H] and RV; MRS/CNN fields distinct

sources.quality_contract: Keep CaT errors, EW/magnitude/method flags and repeat identity. LASP needs S/N, subclass, error and parameter validity masks; CNN uncertainties cannot be invented.
sources.dependency_contract: Learned pipelines inherit training/reference scales; CaT Fe/H depends on calibration and luminosity proxy. Do not confuse older Li high-resolution sample with Li2025 CaT.
sources.next_action: Pin product/pipeline before mapping; DR12 public release is a candidate, not staged or trained data.

sources.release: SDSS DR17 parameter VAC v2 recommended; exact file revision to pin

native_fields.candidate: method-specific Teff/logg/[Fe/H], and master median; exact native column mapping pending

sources.quality_contract: Use goodstars/goodspec and per-method validity/errors. Preserve visit and star keys, uncertainty definitions and Gaia crossmatch ambiguity.
sources.dependency_contract: Four alternative method sets share spectra; three Fe/H sets calibrated to APOGEE. Master median and its constituents cannot be counted as independent labels.
sources.next_action: Freeze VAC version; retain alternative posterior/method evidence. No assumption that library diversity gives a uniform or independent training sample.

sources.release: DR17 SDSS/SEGUE optical; separate from newer BOSS/Astra

native_fields.identity: specObjID / plate-MJD-fiber spectrum identity; NOT Gaia source_id
native_fields.labels: sppParams SSPP Teff/logg/[Fe/H]; exact adopted/error field mapping pending

sources.quality_contract: Select appropriate stellar SSPP domain, quality/SNR/flags and spectroscopic primary rules; verify specObjID join and Gaia association, retain repeats.
sources.dependency_contract: SpecObj is not a stellar atmospheric label pipeline. SSPP methods share spectra/reference scales. Duplicate visits must not cross split boundaries.
sources.next_action: Map explicit sppParams adopted/error columns and units; never manufacture atmospheric labels from spectral classification or redshift.
